materialize.openHint: Turn every link into Puppeteer's old library (HOME and every project) into a file of its own. You see the list first.
materialize.title: Turn links into files
materialize.intro:
Skills, rules, commands and agents Puppeteer linked from its old library are shared: editing one changes it in every project linked to it.
Each link below becomes a copy of its own, with the same content. Puppeteer's blocks in a project's AGENTS.md keep their text and lose only their markers. Nothing else is touched.
materialize.nothing: Nothing to change: no link into Puppeteer's old library is left.
materialize.inGitWarning: {count} of these are tracked by git: the change shows up in the repo and goes into your next commit.
materialize.failed: Stopped at {path}: {error}. What was converted before it stays converted.
materialize.libraryKept: The old library stays as it is. Each change is logged.
